scope: Real initialization/preparation, initial publication, then complete native AePreProcess/AeProcessing wrappers on persistent contexts versus profile-bound Rust standard linear sessions.
limitations: Fixed-rate ordinary auto SC3336 profile; backlight/overexposure/lux/automatic-flicker/HDR/iris/DCG modes remain excluded from the Rust session.
Allocation, module lookup, memory primitives, integer division and logs are modeled; native pinned uClibc math executes.

Only listed preprocessing/controller/publication/sample state, full exposure-info record, publication records, control history and route times are compared; AE pre-result normalized brightness at offset 0x34 is additionally checked against its source; other unlisted context and ISP/pre-result structures excluded.
Effective exposure for each frame is the previous native proposal, replayed as an explicit common input; this is not physical application latency or hardware association. No sensor/ISP writes.
